rccl_install._comment_nfs_install: If nfs_install is True, rccl-tests and rccl library (optional) will be installed in NFS. Otherwise, all nodes will have local installation
rccl_install._comment_rccl_lib_install: False (default) takes the default value of rccl_lib_install_dir (/opt/rocm/lib). If you build custom RCCL library, change this to True and change rccl_lib_install_dir to point to the directory where you will be building RCCL library.
rccl_install._comment_rccl_lib_build_timeout: SSH exec timeout in seconds for RCCL library source build. Some rccl lib tags take long time to build, thus the high timeout value, this upper bound doesn't have effect on actual build time
rccl_install._comment_rccl_lib_install_dir: Ignored when rccl_lib_install is False (bundled ROCm RCCL under rocm_path/lib is used). When rccl_lib_install is True, change this to a writable directory where the custom RCCL library will be cloned and built.
rccl_install._comment_rccl_tests_install_dir: Directory for sparse/full clone of rccl-tests (rocm-systems root). Binaries: <this-dir>/projects/rccl-tests/build when using rocm-systems sparse checkout.
rccl_install._comment_rccl_repository: Monorepo URL; install_rccl_tests sparse-checkouts projects/rccl and projects/rccl-tests automatically.
rccl_install._comment_rccl_sparse_path: Optional overrides for git sparse-checkout paths. Omit or leave as-is for rocm-systems defaults.
rccl_install._comment_rccl_tests_sparse_path: Optional overrides for git sparse-checkout paths. Omit or leave as-is for rocm-systems defaults.
rccl_install._comment_rccl_git_tag: Git tag or branch for projects/rccl sparse checkout from rccl_repository. Recommended: therock-7.11 for ROCm 7.2.0 (validated in CVS testing). See https://github.com/ROCm/rocm-systems/blob/therock-7.11/projects/rccl/CHANGELOG.md for release notes.
rccl_install._comment_rccl_tests_git_tag: Git tag or branch for projects/rccl-tests sparse checkout. Recommended: therock-7.11 for ROCm 7.2.0 (validated in CVS testing).
rccl_install._comment_rocm_path: ROCm install root for HIP/ROCm builds. When rccl_lib_install is False, bundled librccl under <rocm_path>/lib is used.
rccl_install._comment_gpu_arch: Target GPU architecture for RCCL library cmake (-DAMDGPU_TARGETS) and rccl-tests make (AMDGPU_TARGETS/GPU_TARGETS). Required when rccl_lib_install is True — auto-detection failure aborts the build. Strongly recommended to set explicitly; auto-detection via rocminfo is a fallback only. Example: 'gfx942' for MI300X, 'gfx1250' for MI455X.
rccl_install._comment_rccl_tests_use_amdclang: If True, rccl-tests builds with HIPCC/CXX set to $ROCM_PATH/llvm/bin/amdclang++. If False, uses $ROCM_PATH/bin/hipcc.
rccl_install._comment_ompi_install_dir: Open MPI install prefix (OMPI_PREFIX / MPI_HOME). Required for rccl-tests MPI build.
